name: example-implement-review-quickstart-salary-range-fixup
goal: Fix the quickstart salary-range docs and tests so the promoted feature matches its controller contract and passes validation.

sharedContext.summary: The promoted `/api/employees/by-salary-range` endpoint already clamps `minSalary` to zero and normalizes `maxSalary` so it is at least `minSalary`. Update the quickstart README and tests so they match that contract and the quickstart Maven tests pass. Keep the fix bounded to docs/tests; do not edit controller code.
constraints: Keep work bounded to the Spring Boot starter quickstart example.
Do not edit controller code for this fix-up; adjust docs/tests only.
Do not edit TODO.md, ai/state files, ai/log files, or ai/indexes.

tasks.title: Fix quickstart salary-range docs and tests
tasks.prompt: Update the quickstart README and salary-range tests so they match the existing controller contract. In particular, the controller normalizes `maxSalary` to at least `minSalary`, so the tests and docs must reflect the actual outcome for `maxSalary < minSalary`. Keep the fix bounded to README and tests; do not edit the controller.

tasks.title: Review the quickstart salary-range docs and tests fix
tasks.prompt: Review the quickstart salary-range docs/tests fix for correctness and whether it now matches the existing controller contract. Focus on regressions, missing coverage, and whether the Maven test failure should now be resolved.
